label: rem:kummer-filtration-obstruction
title: The Kummer filtration of the obstruction space
html:
Remark. The Kummer filtration of the obstruction space

The obstruction classes \kappa_n \in H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathcal{B}) (quantum characteristic classes) reside in the second cohomology of the state bundle with coefficients in the band \mathcal{B} = \mathcal{O}_M^\times. In the archimedean realisation, \mathcal{B} = \mathbb{G}_m, the multiplicative group scheme. The torsion structure of \mathbb{G}_m imposes a natural filtration on the obstruction space.

The Kummer exact sequence. For each integer n \geq 1, the n-th power map on \mathbb{G}_m fits into a short exact sequence of sheaves on \mathcal{S}:

  1  \longrightarrow  \mu_n
   \longrightarrow  \mathbb{G}_m
  \xrightarrow{(\cdot)^n}
  \mathbb{G}_m
   \longrightarrow  1.

The group scheme \mu_n = \{\zeta \in \mathbb{G}_m : \zeta^n = 1\} consists of the n-th roots of unity. The associated long exact sequence in cohomology provides a connecting homomorphism and a reduction map at every level n:

  \cdots  \to 
  H^1(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m)
  \xrightarrow{\partial}
  H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mu_n)
   \to 
  H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m)
  \xrightarrow{(\cdot)^n}
  H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m)
   \to  \cdots

The Kummer reduction of an obstruction class \kappa at level n is its image under the quotient:

  \kappa \bmod n
   \in 
  H^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m)
  \big/
  nH^2(\mathcal{S}, \mathbb{G}_m).

This reduction measures whether \kappa is n-divisible in the obstruction group.
